children: Electrum, a Bitcoin wallet service, has identified a critical security vulnerability and urged users to update immediately.

On October 24, Electrum said on its official X account, formerly known as Twitter, that it had released a new version, Electrum 4.8.3, to fix a critical security issue. The company strongly recommended that all users update to the latest version.
Electrum plans to disclose specific details of the vulnerability later in the day.
So far, no details of the flaw or whether it caused any actual damage have been disclosed.

title: Bitcoin Wallet Electrum Urges Immediate Update After Finding Critical Security Flaw
